name: Wall Street
author: Austin
summary: Runs weekday paper-trading sessions and records positions, reasoning, and profit or loss for a fictional portfolio.
starterPrompt: Explain how you run a paper-trading session. Help me set up a fictional portfolio and show the sources and assumptions behind each proposed position.
usageNote: For simulated trades only. Results are not financial advice or evidence of future returns; do not connect a live brokerage account.
